limitations: Counts submitted/presented commands, not optical display refresh. GPU utilization and media decoder drops are unmeasured; local session may use a virtual display. Five seconds does not establish show-length stability.
method: 300 real visible MTKView drawable submissions paced toward 60 Hz; presentDrawable; no CPU pixel readback in interval
scope: Visible local drawable benchmark; external projector/display and long show soak remain unverified.
source: Own procedural gradient, checker, grid and solid; no codec or video decoding in this benchmark
